topic: Template Function with Predicate for Range-Based Algorithms
explanation: This concept, the 'none_of' algorithm applies a predicate to each element in a range and returns true if none of the elements satisfy the predicate. Using templates allows this function to work with any iterator type and predicate, exemplifying C++'s emphasis on generic programming and type abstraction, especially in the context of the Standard Template Library (STL).
keywords: C++ none_of implementation, generic algorithm predicate, C++ range algorithm template, STL-style algorithm
